text: Not as often as I used to, mainly because I watch more series now. I'd say I see a film maybe once or twice a month, usually at home on a Friday evening, when I'm too tired to do anything else but still want to switch off properly.

tips.en: Not as often as I used to explains the change at once.
tips.kk: Not as often as I used to — өзгерісті бірден түсіндіреді.
tips.ru: Not as often as I used to — сразу объясняет перемену.
tips.example: Not as often as I used to

tips.en: How often, where and when — a specific answer.
tips.kk: Қаншалықты жиі, қайда және қашан — нақты жауап.
tips.ru: Как часто, где и когда — конкретный ответ.
tips.example: maybe once or twice a month, usually at home on a Friday evening

note.en: A phrasal verb: stop thinking and relax.
A soft way to give an estimate.

questions.followUp: Where do you usually watch them?
questions.question: Do you often watch films?

text: I'm a big fan of science fiction, especially films that make you think rather than just ones full of explosions. I also enjoy a good documentary now and then, because I like learning something real while being entertained at the same time.

tips.en: Especially and rather than show taste more precisely than a genre name.
tips.kk: Especially және rather than талғамды жай жанрдан дәлірек көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Especially и rather than показывают вкус точнее, чем просто жанр.
tips.example: especially films that make you think rather than just ones full of explosions

tips.en: The answer is developed with a second example and a reason.
tips.kk: Жауап екінші мысалмен және түсіндірмемен дамыған.
tips.ru: Ответ развит вторым примером и объяснением.

title.en: A second genre with a reason

tips.example: I also enjoy a good documentary now and then

questions.question: What kind of films do you like?

text: For big, spectacular films I definitely prefer the cinema — the huge screen and the sound make it a completely different experience. For anything else, I'd rather stay at home, where I can pause it, make a cup of tea and not worry about someone checking their phone next to me.

tips.en: Two cases with reasons — a full answer to an either-or question.
tips.kk: Себептері бар екі жағдай — «не-не» сұрағына толық жауап.
tips.ru: Два случая с причинами — полный ответ на «или-или».

title.en: A choice by type of film

tips.example: For big, spectacular films I definitely prefer the cinema

tips.en: The lively detail about a neighbour’s phone makes the answer natural.
tips.kk: Телефоны бар көрші туралы тірі дерек жауапты табиғи етеді.
tips.ru: Живая деталь про соседа с телефоном делает ответ естественным.
tips.example: someone checking their phone next to me

questions.followUp: When did you last go to the cinema?
questions.question: Do you prefer watching films at home or in the cinema?

text: Yes, Interstellar — I think I've seen it three times now. The first time I was just amazed by the visuals, but when I watched it again I started noticing all the small details in the story that I'd completely missed before.

tips.en: A specific film and what changed on each viewing.
tips.kk: Нақты фильм және қайта көргенде не өзгергені.
tips.ru: Конкретный фильм и что менялось при пересмотре.
tips.example: I think I've seen it three times now

tips.en: I’d completely missed — the right tense for “earlier than that”.
tips.kk: I’d completely missed — «бұрын, одан ертерек» үшін дәл шақ.
tips.ru: I’d completely missed — точное время для «раньше, до того».

questions.followUp: Why did you watch it again?
questions.question: Is there a film you have watched more than once?

text: Definitely, especially historical films and documentaries. Of course they're not always accurate, but they can make a period of history feel real in a way that a textbook rarely does. A good film often makes me curious enough to read more about the topic afterwards.

tips.en: Of course… but admits a weakness but keeps the position.
tips.kk: Of course… but — әлсіз тұсты мойындап, ұстанымды сақтайды.
tips.ru: Of course… but — признаёт слабость, но сохраняет позицию.
tips.example: Of course they're not always accurate

tips.en: The comparison shows what films add.
tips.ru: Сравнение показывает, в чём ценность фильмов.
tips.example: in a way that a textbook rarely does

questions.question: Do you think films can teach us something?
